## Overview
This vignette demonstrates how chromosome arm mean expression profiles can be summarised across annotated cell populations. In this ovarian cancer dataset, epithelial and tumour-associated populations exhibit distinct chromosome arm level expression patterns compared with other cell types, highlighting the importance of reference selection for SCNA inference.

## Load libraries
```{r load libraries}
# Load libraries
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(SpatialCopyInference)
library(purrr)
```

## Set plot settings
```{r plot settings}
# Set manual colours from palette
manual_col <- c("Proliferative Tumour Cells" = "#F1CE63",
                "MT-High, Jun+/Fos+ Tumour Cells" = "#86BCB6",
                "VEGFA+ Tumour Cells" = "#FABFD2",
                "Tumour Cells" = "#D37295",
                "Fallopian Tube Epithelium" = "#59A14F",
                "Macrophages" = "#8CD17D",
                "Tumour Associated Ciliated Epithelial Cells" = "#A0CBE8",
                "Ciliated Epithelial Cells" = "#4E79A7",
                "T & NK Cells" = "#79706E",
                "Tumour Associated Fibroblasts" = "#BAB0AC",
                "Malignant Cells Lining Cyst" = "#B6992D",
                "Endothelial Cells" = "#D7B5A6",
                "Stromal Associated Fibroblasts" = "#FF9D9A",
                "Pericytes" = "#499894",
                "Smooth Muscle Cells" = "#E15759",
                "Inflammatory Tumour Cells" = "#B07AA1",
                "Granulosa Cells" = "#FFBE7D",
                "Secretory Epithelial Cells" = "#F28E2B")

# Add legend order
legend_order <- c("Tumour Cells", "Inflammatory Tumour Cells", "Proliferative Tumour Cells", "VEGFA+ Tumour Cells", "MT-High, Jun+/Fos+ Tumour Cells", "Malignant Cells Lining Cyst", "Tumour Associated Fibroblasts", "Tumour Associated Ciliated Epithelial Cells", "Fallopian Tube Epithelium", "Secretory Epithelial Cells", "Ciliated Epithelial Cells", "Granulosa Cells","Endothelial Cells", "Pericytes", "Stromal Associated Fibroblasts", "Smooth Muscle Cells", "Macrophages", "T & NK Cells")
```

## Import data

```{r Import data example paths, eval = FALSE}
# Path to Xenium output directory
data_dir <- "path/to/Xenium_outputs/outs"

# Path to refined cell type annotations
annotation_file <- "path/to/cell_type_annotations.csv"
```

## Run pipeline
```{r, Run pipeline, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE}
# Import data
xenium.obj <- import_xenium(data_dir, annotation_file)

# Quality control
xenium.obj <- filter_cells(xenium.obj)
xenium.obj <- filter_genes(xenium.obj, min_cells = 50, min_counts = 50)

# Normalisation
xenium.obj <- normalise_data(xenium.obj)
```

## Comparison of cell means
Chromosome arm mean profiles were computed separately for each annotated cell population using `compute_reference()`. The resulting chromosome arm level mean expression values can then be compared across cell types.
```{r Compute cell type means, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE}
# Compute references for each cell type
all_group_refs <- purrr::map_dfr(
  unique(xenium.obj$group),
  function(g) {
    compute_reference(
      xenium.obj,
      group_var= "group",
      group_names = g
    ) %>%
      mutate(group = g)
  }
)
```

Chromosome arm means for each cell type are shown below.

```{r Plot all chromosome means, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE, out.width = "100%"}
# Supplementary Figure 1: Mean chromosome arm-level gene expression across different cell types.
ggplot() +
  geom_vline(xintercept=hg38_chrom_info$cum_centromere_mid, linetype =  "dashed",linewidth = .3) +
  geom_vline(xintercept=hg38_chrom_info$cum_length,linewidth = .3) +
  geom_segment(
    data = all_group_refs %>% filter(arm == "p"),
    aes(x = p_start, xend = p_end, y = mean_arm_expr, 
        colour = group),
    linewidth = .8, linetype = "11") +
  geom_segment(data = all_group_refs %>% filter(arm == "q"),
    aes(x = q_start, xend = q_end, y = mean_arm_expr, 
        colour = group),
    linewidth = .8, linetype = "11") +
  scale_colour_manual(
    values = c(manual_col, "Global mean" = "black"), breaks = legend_order) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks =hg38_chrom_info$cum_chromosome_mid , labels = hg38_chrom_info$chrom, expand = c(0,0)) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(axis.text.x=element_text(colour="black", size=8)) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 50, hjust = 1)) +
  theme(axis.text.y=element_text(colour="black", size=9)) +
  theme(axis.title.x=element_text(colour="black", size=8)) +
  theme(axis.title.y=element_text(colour="black", size=8)) +
  theme(legend.text=element_text(colour="black", size=8)) +
  ylim(0,1) +
  theme(legend.position="right") +
  theme(legend.title = element_blank())+
  ylab("Log-normalised expression") +
  xlab("Chromosome") +
  ggtitle("Cell type arm means")
```

To facilitate visual comparison, four representative cell populations are shown across chromosomes 1–4 below.
```{r Plot representative means, out.width="100%", warning = FALSE, message = FALSE}
hg38_chrom_info_sub <- hg38_chrom_info %>%  filter(chrom %in% paste0("chr", 1:4))

groups_to_plot <- c("Fallopian Tube Epithelium", "Endothelial Cells", "Proliferative Tumour Cells", "Tumour Cells" )
arm_means_sub <- all_group_refs %>%  filter(chrom %in% paste0("chr", 1:4), group %in% groups_to_plot)

# Fig 1B: Mean log-normalised chromosome arm-level gene expression across representative cell populations
ggplot() +
  geom_vline(xintercept=hg38_chrom_info_sub$cum_centromere_mid, linetype =  "dashed",linewidth = .3) +
  geom_vline(xintercept=hg38_chrom_info_sub$cum_length,linewidth = .3) +
  geom_segment(
    data = arm_means_sub %>% filter(arm == "p"),
    aes(x = p_start, xend = p_end, y = mean_arm_expr, 
        colour = group),
    linewidth = .6, linetype = "11") +
  geom_segment(data = arm_means_sub %>% filter(arm == "q"),
               aes(x = q_start, xend = q_end, y = mean_arm_expr, 
                   colour = group),
               linewidth = .6, linetype = "11") +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c(manual_col), breaks = legend_order) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks =hg38_chrom_info_sub$cum_chromosome_mid , labels =   hg38_chrom_info_sub$chrom, expand = c(0,0)) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(axis.text.x=element_text(colour="black", size=9)) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 50, hjust = 1)) +
  theme(axis.text.y=element_text(colour="black", size=9)) +
  theme(axis.title.x=element_blank()) +
  theme(axis.title.y=element_text(colour="black", size=10)) +
  theme(legend.text=element_text(colour="black", size=6)) +
  ylim(0,1) +
  theme(legend.position="bottom") +
  theme(legend.title = element_blank())+
  ylab("Log-normalised expression")
```
